I played with my friends for less than an hour and we detected some pitfalls that ruined the experience. The game is good, and the gameplay and mechanics are interesting. It has potential, really, but we get tired too soon to continue playing. Here I share some details I notice that, unless for me, ruined the experience.

Instruccions:
The display of the instructions is unclear as the description of the current challenge. Somehow this HUD looks "'hidden" when it really isn't but for the overall info in the screen it's hard to read and understand. Also, in the "card" game, the left box showing the state of the match has a bug showing wrong and unclear the text.

Tempo:
In the overall experience I noticed the tempo of the gameplay slow. In the "drawing" challenge, the time to draw is not enough, in contrast with the time of discussion and voting which makes this part slow.

Sound:
The music and "noise" from the characters is too high in comparison with the chat voice. It's really difficult and annoying to have a conversation while some characters are making noise continuously, the sound part needs an adjustment.

Pointer:
It's hard to cut the wires, and pick the cards from the other players with the camera movement.
